name: Route 31 & Route 30 Mr. Pokémon Homestead
summary: Travel east from Violet City through Route 31 and head south along the rural orchards of Route 30. Visit the eccentric Mr. Pokémon in his cottage, exploring his shed to retrieve an Air Balloon. Gather hidden vitamin items across the lake and battle countryside trainers on your way south toward Cherrygrove City.

items.name: Air Balloon
items.method: Found sitting inside Mr. Pokémon's wooden garden shed on Route 30

items.name: Full Heal
items.method: Found lying on the grassy verge south of Mr. Pokémon's residence

items.name: Iron
items.method: Located on the secluded southern embankment across the small lake

items.name: Grepa Berry
items.method: Daily random harvest from the Route 30 berry grove

items.name: Tamato Berry
items.method: Daily random harvest from the Route 30 berry grove
